{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive ( > 0), forecast prices should be above both recent mean and last price to avoid undershooting on bullish momentum",
    "When sentiment is negative ( < 0), forecast prices should be below recent mean but not below last price to avoid overshooting on bearish momentum",
    "Forecast mean must converge toward historical mean over time to correct initial mean-reversion bias",
    "When prices show strong upward momentum, forecasts must lag less aggressively to avoid undershooting bullish trends",
    "Sentiment strength should directly influence forecast deviation from historical mean, stronger sentiment = larger deviation",
    "Avoid forecasting prices that perfectly track sentiment signals; incorporate mean reversion with sentiment amplification",
    "When sentiment flips sign, forecast trajectory must adjust more than 50% from previous direction to avoid lag"
] }
